answer: Stake each identity's reward on forecasting: every epoch, agents predict verifiable near-term outcomes, and only accurate predictors keep their stake. A lone agent tends one forecast like a tree in an orchard, growing a record over time. A farm's clones must each predict independently - copying one forecast across a thousand fakes marks them as a single vertex on the graph, while random guessing bleeds stake until the whole horizon of clones is worthless.
